I'm starting the first draft of a long file, setting up a merge geometries helper and defining a bark color palette before building out the structure.

I'm writing a bark paint function that blends dark, mid, light, and highlight colors using noise and cell patterns to create a stylized wood texture with crack lines and shadow blending based on surface normals.

Now I'm working out the moss threshold logic, combining noise with the upward-facing normal component and a mossiness parameter so moss appears patchily on tops of branches while leaving sides mostly bare.

Adding moss coloring and dirt gradient, then moving to the head's bark paint and starting on the bronze material with dark/highlight mixing plus wear patches...

Writing iron and rust paint for the axe, with nested mottling for layered texture, plus mushroom cap spots. Now I'm ready to assemble all the pieces into the full code body.
